shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规地呈现产品与包装

style.backgroundSystem: deep violet gradient #241238 with dark reflective liquid surfaces for claim, detail and comparison shots; seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot; white refrigerator interior #F2F3F5 for the in-use scene; softly blurred kitchen for the closing lifestyle shot
style.iconSystem: thin monoline line-art icons only (droplet, calendar, check mark, cross), single bright violet accent #8B5CF6, consistent stroke weight
style.lightingSystem: dramatic cool studio lighting with a cool rim light and glossy specular highlights on water and glass; soft controlled key on the product; soft contact shadows; cool color temperature around 5500K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium water-filtration tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep violet background #241238, clean white #FFFFFF, cool off-white text #F5F3FA and one bright violet accent #8B5CF6; cool color temperature; dramatic cool studio lighting with a cool rim light and glossy specular highlights on water and glass; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin monoline line-art icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the filter cartridge shown upright and stable, alone or beside its slim retail box; consistent scale and vertical alignment across the set; internal structure shown only as a clean sectioned cutaway
style.surfaceSystem: glossy dark reflective water-like surface for hero and infographic shots; matte seamless white studio surface for the packshot; glossy kitchen counter for the lifestyle close
style.typography: single modern geometric sans-serif family; bold white headlines on dark, never serif or decorative
